children: Aeva’s revenue rose 86% year over year as product sales and non-recurring engineering services increased. Net income fell sharply from the year-ago quarter, when a fair-value gain on the share subscription liability and a larger gain on warrant liabilities boosted results; operating loss widened as research and development and general and administrative expenses increased.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Increased 107% to $3.5M, primarily on higher unit sales, partly offset by a lower average selling price.
: Revenue rose 68% to $3.2M, primarily due to higher development activity for non-recurring engineering services.
: Rose to $2.2M from $430K as revenue growth outpaced the increase in cost of revenues.
: Expenses increased 30% to $28.9M, primarily due to higher payroll, materials and services, and software license costs.
: Were $26.1M at September 30, 2026; about 36% is expected to be recognized as revenue over the next 12 months.
